assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Sick sinus syndrome is coded as I49.5
Atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery is coded as I25.10
The CPT code for the service is 93229
The monitoring is intended to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The monitoring is intended to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
